label: Exact output-range conditions for local-law and uniform-forecast obstructions
paraphrase: For one fixed selector of complete Boolean traces and one recorded all-true prefix: adjacent-pair richness is equivalent to every first-order, possibly time-dependent Profile true on all admitted traces allowing every fully unobserved pair. At a selected coordinate, admission of both Boolean values is equivalent to failure of exact uniform correctness for every record-only estimator. Finite richness implies pair richness, which implies both values at every future coordinate. The existing populated one-step extension theorem therefore already gives pair richness without infinite-prefix closure. These equivalences identify exact conditions within the specified observation and estimator classes, not weakest metaphysical premises or the absence of all kinds of laws.
